title: Run a local security self-check
description: Run a small defensive checklist against your own Cyber Lab Pro workspace and print the results.
code:
from pathlib import Path
import os

checks = {
    "Lab folder exists": (Path.home() / "cyber-lab").is_dir(),
    "No hard-coded demo secret in this script": "PASTE_REAL_API_KEY" not in Path(__file__).read_text(errors="ignore") if "__file__" in globals() else True,
    "Python is running": True,
}

print("CYBER LAB PRO — LOCAL SELF-CHECK")
for name, passed in checks.items():
    print(f"[{'PASS' if passed else 'REVIEW'}] {name}")

print("\nThis is a basic learning checklist, not a full security audit.")
